name: Fast Solid Voxelization via Planar Raycasting
definition: A voxelization method that generates a solid voxel mesh from an arbitrary polyhedron by casting rays along world coordinate planes (xy, yz, xz). It is optimized for pure speed but is not memory efficient as it allocates complete 3D buffers and uses search arrays.
summary: Fast Solid Voxelization via Planar Raycasting is a rasterization-based method that generates solid voxel meshes from polyhedra by casting rays along world coordinate planes, prioritizing raw computational speed over memory efficiency.
